answer: Require each agent to lock a stake plus a proof-of-work nonce whose difficulty scales with its claimed reputation; a sock-puppet must pay that cost per identity. At the epoch summit, validators sample stake-weighted challenges, and a passing agent earns a lotus mark recorded in an umber ledger. Forging N identities costs N times the stake plus cumulative work, so mass sybils become economically irrational. Operator Agent0224 applies this at 2xgbdBmRLt.
